title: Manager at IT Solutions Provider Expects Teradata Business to Be Flat or Decline Up to 5% in 2027
expert: Manager at a large IT solutions provider (current; ~20 years in a Northeast territory, Fortune 50–500 clients)
verdict: Teradata was in none of the expert's last five to seven cloud-first AI deals, Q4 2026 Teradata business was only flat to up 0%–3% y/y, and the pipeline is almost 100% renewals; he expects about -5% in Q1 2027.

Cloud ARR: 🔴 Teradata Cloud spend 0%–5% at most y/y in Q4 2026; well below the 2026-11-09 call's footprint +12%–15% y/y: conflicting. [25 • Expert Call](https://research.alpha-sense.com?docid=EC-1000000-270247&scope=ANYWHERE&stmt=fse22871&hl=fse22871,fse23132,fse23179,fse23201,fse23353&page=2)
Demand / renewals: 🔴 Pipeline almost 100% renewals, no new greenfield; vs net new 10% of pipeline in the 2026-11-09 call: weaker. [13 • Expert Call](https://research.alpha-sense.com?docid=EC-1000000-270247&scope=ANYWHERE&stmt=fse37213&hl=fse37213,fse38386&page=2)

🔴 Q1 2027 about -5% y/y; calendar 2027 flat to -0%–5% (estimate); first expert forecast of decline for 2027. [15 • Expert Call](https://research.alpha-sense.com?docid=EC-1000000-270247&scope=ANYWHERE&stmt=fse35531&hl=fse35531,fse35591,fse44493,fse45217&page=2)
Pricing & competition: 🔴 List +5%–8% but many renewals flat; customers shifting from three- and five-year terms to single-year and month-to-month; first read on contract terms. [6 • Expert Call](https://research.alpha-sense.com?docid=EC-1000000-270247&scope=ANYWHERE&stmt=fse45756&hl=fse45756&page=2)

🔴 Teradata in none of the last five to seven cloud-first AI deals; Snowflake, Databricks and Microsoft Fabric gaining; consistent with the 2026-11-09 call. changes: Cloud: Teradata Cloud spend 0%–5% y/y in Q4 2026 (expert) vs the 2026-11-09 call's software footprint +12%–15% y/y and consumption ~4% q/q: conflicting.
Pipeline: almost 100% renewals, no greenfield (expert) vs the 2026-11-09 call's pipeline of migration 50%–55%, expansion 25%, net new 10%: weaker.
Pricing: list +5%–8% but many renewals flat (expert); first read on Teradata price realization before 2026-11-10.
First read on contract terms shortening from three/five-year to single-year and month-to-month; no earlier expert call or stored row.
thesis_impact: No tenets on the TDC page; against its pitch (cloud ARR growth, total ARR 8–12%, 75%+ FCF returns): Cloud ARR ↓ — Teradata Cloud spend only 0%–5% y/y in this book; total ARR ↓ — flat 2026, about -5% Q1 2027; FCF/buybacks ↓ — flat renewals on 5%–8% list increases and shorter terms reduce visibility.
